evidence.detail: R357 LauncherSidePanel installs rs/gui/b/h as the exact tab labeled 'Loadouts'.
The panel owns the visible Loadout folders selector plus Create, Delete, Rename, Move up and Move down controls, and it initializes the persisted 'Main folder' state.
R143/R345 already recover the exact model/persistence graph consumed by this panel: LoadoutDefinition, LoadoutFolder, LoadoutManager, LoadoutPersistence, LoadoutBinaryCodec and version detector.
The panel exposes the live loadout manager/folder UI, active folder combo box and popup/action surfaces used by the recovered spawn/edit flows.

evidence.detail: R357 LauncherSidePanel installs rs/s/c/d as the exact 'Development' tab when developer UI is enabled.
The panel exposes Reset Item Defs (::itemdef reset), Reset NPC Defs (::resetnpcdefs) and Repack cache (::repack) controls.
It presents and manages exact Recoloring NPC / Recoloring Item / Recoloring Object states, color-list selection, Color inverse, Hide modified and Copy selected developer controls.
The same surface directly operates definition/recolor tooling and launcher refresh state; it is not a normal gameplay-facing panel.

evidence.detail: R357 LauncherSidePanel installs rs/gui/a/a as the exact 'GPU (Beta)' tab.
The panel renders the exact 'GPU Settings' section with GPU Mode, Anti Aliasing, VSync Mode, Colorblind Mode, Anisotropic filtering and Smooth banding controls.
The same panel renders the exact 'Stretched Mode Settings' section with Stretched Mode, Maintain aspect ratio and UI Scaling controls and emits the exact ::stretchflagoff / ::stretchflagon commands.
Its controls read/write the same GPU/config state used by the recovered GPU subsystem, while the panel itself remains launcher-side presentation/configuration.
